methods.label: Find and combine the tennis counts
methods.explanation:
The schools have different numbers of students, so first find how many students at each school prefer tennis. The charts give tennis shares of \(22\%\) at East and \(40\%\) at West. Thus the tennis counts are
\[
0.22\times2000=440,
\qquad
0.40\times2500=1000.
\]
Together, \(440+1000=1440\) out of \(2000+2500=4500\) students prefer tennis. Their percentage is
\[
\frac{1440}{4500}\times100\%=32\%.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{32\%}\), choice C.
